product_metadata.title: Tea Bag Organizer 6 Compartments by HTB|  Gift Box Bamboo Tea Organizer for Tea Bags with Acrylic Transparent Hinged Lid
features: SMOOTH & NATURAL BAMBOO: Bamboo is durable and healthier than any acrylic. the damp-proof coating makes it easy to clean and will never splinter and is water resistant. Without burrs or sharp edges.

MAKE STORAGE MORE SIMPLE: If you are struggling with your packets and want something to organize them, our tea box will be a great choice for you. It is perfect for organizing tea bags, creamers, sugar salt pepper packets, sweeteners, instant coffee or tea packets, water flavorings, vitamin packets, and other small packets.

LARGE CAPACITY: Overall - 10.5" X 8.5" X 3.7"; Each Compartment - 3" X 3.7" X 2.7". it has a large capacity, each tea bag holder compartment can hold 15 tea bags. Has 6 equally divided compartments to hold your tea.
HINGED LID: Hinged lid easily opens to make grabbing what you need simple; the clear acrylic lid makes it easy to see what is stored inside.

GIFT BOX - Our tea box organizer comes with a gift box. It will be the perfect, thoughtful, and pampering Christmas gift for that special friend or relative who is a tea connoisseur, or for that loved one who simply loves to enjoy their little tea ritual every evening.
